name: Ship Capture
author: Mr_fun1_1
description:
WARNING: This mod's values and balance implications should be adjusted to your own preference in Mod Settings before use.

Seize enemy ship control by hacking and boarding:
- Hacking Array (hull mod): locks onto an unmanned ship (Remnant automated ships / drones), hijacks it until control is taken;
- Hacking Terminal (toggle): enables hacking of Tesseract (Omega) ships and their faction in Mod Settings, off by default;
- Boarding Pod (fighter wing): accumulates boarding hits against manned ships until control is taken;
- Boarding Driver Core (hull mod): triggers electronic-interference malfunctions (engine / weapons / shield) on the boarding side;
- When a target is destroyed, one-shot boarding fighters are released according to its accumulated boarding count;
Captured ships join your fleet directly after the battle.

--- Author's Note ---
Thank you for downloading and playing. I am a complete coding novice - I did not write a single line of code for this mod (😂); it was entirely cobbled together by the AI (Doubao) referencing various other mods and vanilla code.
This is my first attempt to turn my ideas into a mod. If anything offends you, please forgive me - I am truly sorry!
